abstract: Maintains base de-icing support availability and winterization servicing costs
system_message:
You are the Alpine ground base superintendent (GROUND), responsible for maintaining base de-icing support availability and winterization servicing costs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aviation fuel reserves（FUEL）
information_points.content:
GROUND-FUEL-589：Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight maintains a stored Jet-A1 fuel volume of 22000 L across forward mountain staging helipad fuel tanks.
GROUND-FUEL-N38：Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group maintains a stored Jet-A1 fuel volume of 30000 L across forward mountain staging helipad fuel tanks.
GROUND-FUEL-E7T：Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service maintains a stored Jet-A1 fuel volume of 15000 L across forward mountain staging helipad fuel tanks.

information_points.title: Maintains base de-icing support availability and winterization servicing costs（BASEOPS）
information_points.content:
GROUND-BASEOPS-UNM：For Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group, operational ground de-icing support across forward alpine base helipads and rotor blade de-icing stations is active and verified, and the cold-weather ground pre-conditioning fee is 2400 NZD per dispatch.
GROUND-BASEOPS-PEB：For Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight, operational ground de-icing support across forward alpine base helipads and rotor blade de-icing stations is not operational, and the cold-weather ground pre-conditioning fee is 1200 NZD per dispatch.
GROUND-BASEOPS-WPL：For Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service, operational ground de-icing support across forward alpine base helipads and rotor blade de-icing stations is active and verified, and the cold-weather ground pre-conditioning fee is 2400 NZD per dispatch.
